nonBlockingRisks.title: Further findings, held back to keep this review focused
nonBlockingRisks.body:
These are recorded rather than commented inline, because none of them fires while the default stays permissive. **They become blocking the moment the default flips to `false`**, so they are worth having on record now.

1. **The reconcile path is not gated** (`internal/controller/workloads/rolebasedgroup_controller.go:1048` gates `Owns()`, but `getOrCreateWorkloadReconciler` at :590 → `pkg/reconciler/workload_reconciler.go:54-69` takes no flag). With the toggle off the controller still builds Deployment/StatefulSet/LWS reconcilers, which then read types whose RBAC this PR removes. Separately, `dynamicWatchCustomCRD` at :1615-1620 re-registers the LeaderWorkerSet watch with no flag check, so "stops watching these resources" does not hold for LWS.

2. **`cacheOptions` drops the `ByObject` entries rather than keeping the label selector** (`cmd/rbgs/main.go:641`). `ByObject` is per-type configuration, not an allowlist — removing the entry does not prevent an informer, it only removes the bound on one that starts. Combined with (1), the first cached Deployment read starts an unbounded cluster-wide informer that can never sync, because this PR removes `list`/`watch` on those types. Keeping the selector in both modes costs nothing.

3. **A partially written value block hard-fails the render, or silently strips the RBAC** (`deploy/helm/rbgs/templates/rbac/clusterrole.yaml:76` and `:119`, `manager.yaml:51`, `NOTES.txt:19` all dereference three levels with no `| default dict`, unlike every pre-existing block in the chart). Measured: `compatibility:` or `compatibility.v1alpha1:` with no children both fail with `nil pointer evaluating interface {}` — an opaque error for a normal thing to write — and `enabled:` left blank renders fine but evaluates falsy, **silently removing the controller's RBAC**. Controls: `--set controller.features=null` and `--set global=null` both render 12/12 valid documents, so this is specific to the unguarded new block.

4. **The upgrade guard blocks the command the repo documents, and is porous the other way** (`deploy/helm/rbgs/templates/upgrade-guard.yaml`). `helm upgrade --install` appears in 10 places, including `deploy/helm/rbgs/README.md:40` — the "Installing" section of the same README that forbids upgrades at lines 33 and 123 — plus `Makefile:253`, `README.md:77`, `README-zh_CN.md:77`, `doc/install.md:30` and `:66`, `doc/dev/how_to_develop.md:294`, `test/stress/scripts/deploy-controller.sh:52`, `.github/workflows/e2e-test.yml:158`, `release-test.yml:117`. Each works exactly once per cluster. Meanwhile `helm template | kubectl apply` and ArgoCD's default Helm mode pass straight through, so it stops the compliant user without stopping the risk.

5. **No CI gate keeps the chart ClusterRole in sync** now that `make manifests` no longer copies it (`Makefile:64-65`). No drift at this head — 209 normalised `(apiGroup, resource, verb)` triples on both sides, empty symmetric difference — so a note, not a defect.

Common thread: **no CI job renders the chart or installs it twice**, which is why items 3-5 and the default-value mismatch are all invisible to CI. That is the same blind spot that let the previous round's render blocker through to the 30-minute e2e job. A `helm template … | kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f -` step in the lint job would catch most of it in seconds.

missingTests.title: No test covers the toggle's effect on existing objects, or the chart render
